title: Wafflenity (Discontinued)
body:
DISCLAIMER: I will not be updating this resource pack any more as someone else has done a better take of this idea. I recommend using HachiroMW's [Autumnity Waffles](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/autumnity-waffles) instead.

Changes [Autumnity](https://modrinth.com/mod/autumnity)'s Pancakes to Waffles, simple as that!



I made this as I have both [Autumnity](https://modrinth.com/mod/autumnity)'s and [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries)' pancakes in my modpack, and rather than removing [Autumnity](https://modrinth.com/mod/autumnity)'s, I decided to turn them into waffles. As of now, only the block model's texture is changed although I may change the item sprite in the future. The pancakes are also renamed to waffles.



Requires [Autumnity](https://modrinth.com/mod/autumnity) of course. Credit to Team Abnormals for making this texture and the peak mod its from.
